Method of Attack: Ransomware-as-a-Service allowing anyone to generate weaponized ransomware binaries without activation fee
Ransomware encrypts files using dual AES and RSA-4096 encryption
Uses PsExec to execute ransomware on other machines in victim networks
Ransomware encrypts files without adding special file extension, placing ransom note in each folder
Affiliates receive share of ransom payments
Impacted Systems: Windows computers infected by Data Keeper ransomware
Attack Vector: Distribution of weaponized ransomware binaries generated via Data Keeper RaaS by multiple threat actors
Indicators of Compromise: Dark Web URL for ransom payment (redacted)
